conventions: Byte strings are lowercase hex. Links, URLs, names, digit codes and JSON text are plain strings; decoded payloads are JSON objects.
Times are milliseconds since the Unix epoch, UTC.
Every secret and nonce here comes from SHA-256("kinfold-test-vector/" || tag); never reuse them outside tests.

hpke_rfc9180.source: RFC 9180 test vectors (github.com/cfrg/draft-irtf-cfrg-hpke, test-vectors.json): mode 0, KEM 0x0020, KDF 0x0001, AEAD 0x0002; first 2 of 257 encryptions
